beats.summary: Darryl and Andy discuss the early stages of hiring new warehouse workers after the old crew won the lottery.

evidence.snippet: Darryl: I have a file of applicants here. I just gotta open it, look at it, interview a bunch of guys,hire some of 'em.

beats.summary: Andy jokes that Darryl is inside of fat Darryl, highlighting Darryl's weight gain.

evidence.snippet: Andy: That is not Darryl. I don't know where Darryl is. I suspect probably our Darryl is inside of fat Darryl.

beats.summary: Dwight insists on handling all 300 boxes himself and crashes a forklift into a warehouse wall.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Negative! Three hundred boxes for me, zero for you chumps. Deal with it!
Dwight runs forklift into wall of warehouse

beats.summary: Andy and Darryl hold a meeting with warehouse job applicants, but the group quickly disperses after Darryl's discouraging remarks.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Welcome, everybody! My name is Andy and this is my other brother Darryl.
Darryl: One of 'em, Glenn, is starting one of those fat camps where he steals your kid in the middle of the night.

beats.summary: Darryl gives a blunt talk to applicants about not settling for just any job, which makes the atmosphere tense.

evidence.snippet: Darryl: Don't just take the first job that comes your way. Cause next thing you know, it's ten years later and you're still there.

Andy: Are we scaring them straight…?
Darryl: I hope so.

beats.summary: After the applicants leave, Andy tells Darryl that his negative attitude caused them to quit, leading Darryl to ask to be fired.

evidence.snippet: Andy: No. Because they all left.
Darryl: Then I think you should fire me.
